name: Team restructure: DevRel split + storefront-team renames in CODEOWNERS / AGENTS.md
description:
Templates & DevRel is being dissolved into three independent teams: DevRel (already split off, live as `@shoptet/devrel-team`), the SOFA team (renamed `@shoptet/storefront-team`), and the 3G / email-templates team, which becomes `@shoptet/storefront-team-3g` — the direct successor of the Templates half of the old Templates & DevRel team, with no DevRel content. All three moves touch the same files, so they ship as one PR.

**Decided 2026-09-21: **`storefront-team` and `storefront-team-3g` are two flat, independent GitHub teams — not a parent/children hierarchy. SOFA sits fully under `storefront-team`; there is no separate `storefront-sofa` handle. Each team gets its own CODEOWNERS lines and its own `.claude/teams/*.md` doc. This supersedes the Option A / Option B slug choice in Step 0 below.

**Syntax blocker: **CODEOWNERS has no nested-team syntax. `@shoptet/storefront-team/3G` is not valid. Owners are always a single flat slug — `@org/team-slug`. GitHub also lowercases slugs, so "3G" becomes `3g`. Moot now that the final model has no nesting at all — kept here as the reason nesting was dropped rather than fought.

Refs: [About code owners](https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/managing-your-repositorys-settings-and-features/customizing-your-repository/about-code-owners) · [About organization teams](https://docs.github.com/en/organizations/organizing-members-into-teams/about-teams)

### Step 0 — handles (decided 2026-09-21)

No parent/child nesting. Two flat, independent teams — `@shoptet/storefront-team` (was the SOFA team) and `@shoptet/storefront-team-3g` (was the Templates half of Templates & DevRel, DevRel-free). `@shoptet/devrel-team` stays top-level, already live. The table below (Option A / Option B) is the discarded history of how this was arrived at.

Today

Option A — prefixed (discarded)

Final (decided)

**Resolved: **both final slugs keep the `-team` convention (`storefront-team`, `storefront-team-3g`), so `.claude/teams/{slug}.md` naturally matches the existing `{team}-team.md` pattern — no wording fix needed in `.claude/README.md`. `/st-ownership` derives the filename straight from the handle, unchanged.

### Current state

- `@shoptet/devrel-team` already exists in CODEOWNERS, Partner Portal, added in . Live, with its own team doc.
- Done in this PR: all `templates-devrel-team` CODEOWNERS lines (`/cms/templates/frontend_templates/**`, `/cms/templates/emails/**`) now point at `@shoptet/storefront-team-3g`, with a matching team doc and command.
- Done in this PR: all `sofa-team` CODEOWNERS lines (`sofa-services.neon`, `cms/packages/Sofa`, `admin/controllers/Sofa`, `admin/react/src/Sofa/**`, `admin/react/src/ThemeEditor/**`, `editorPreview.js`, `/storefront-api`, `/sofa`) now point at `@shoptet/storefront-team` — one flat handle, not a child slug.
- **Resolved: **the `editorPreview.js` carve-out stays. It's a `storefront-team` (SOFA) file living inside the Templates tree — ThemeEditor is SOFA-maintained even though its files sit under `cms/templates/frontend_templates/`.
- No CODEOWNERS validation exists in CI — a broken handle will not be caught by a workflow, only by GitHub silently failing to request review.
- Review note: `/AGENTS.md` and `/.claude/**` are owned by `@shoptet/ai-rnd-team`, so this PR needs their approval on top of the affected teams.

### 1) CODEOWNERS — done

- All `templates-devrel-team` occurrences renamed to `@shoptet/storefront-team-3g`; all `sofa-team` occurrences renamed to `@shoptet/storefront-team`.
- The two blocks stay separate (`# Storefront 3G templates` / `# Storefront SOFA`) — they're two teams now, not sub-comments inside one merged block.
- DevRel block left untouched — those paths were already correct.
- Team-doc CODEOWNERS lines added for `storefront-team.md` and `storefront-team-3g.md` (devrel-team.md already had one).
- Line order preserved — renames done in place, nothing reordered.

### 2) AGENTS.md — done

- "Templates & DevRel" row replaced by two adjacent rows: **Storefront** (SOFA themes, visual editor, Storefront API) and **Storefront 3G** (Smarty templates 2G+3G, transactional emails).
- DevRel row unchanged (Partner Portal).

### 3) Agent config — done

- `.claude/teams/`: `storefront-team.md` rewritten to SOFA only; new `storefront-team-3g.md` added for templates/emails; `devrel-team.md` cross-reference updated to point at `storefront-team-3g.md`.
- `.agents/commands/`: `team-storefront.md` scoped down to SOFA only; new `team-storefront-3g.md` added.
- `docs/agents/COMMANDS.md` — both command rows updated/added.
- The "child GitHub team shares its parent's doc" special case (which only ever described `storefront-3g`/`storefront-sofa`) is removed from `.claude/README.md` and the `/st-ownership` skill — nothing in the repo uses it anymore.
- Verified with `make lint-agents-skills` (clean); run `make lint-agents-rules` before merge too.

### 4) Outside agent config

- Done: `.github/workflows/test-cms4-cypress.yaml` — the `team-check` job now gates on `storefront-team-3g` membership (the templates team), not the SOFA team — matches the "two independent teams" decision, so no policy question left here.
- Left untouched, out of scope: `docs/catalog/contracts/` — 7 prose references to `@shoptet/sofa-team` in Catalog-team planning docs (wave-D / wave-F). Stale after this rename; flagged to Catalog rather than edited here.
- Left untouched per the Slack-channels decision below: `composer.json` `"contact": "#cz3-dev-templates-devrel"`, and the Slack-channel mentions in `docs/ci/README.md`, `docs/ci/scheduled-feature-cleanup-notification.md` and `cms/templates/frontend_templates/docs/accessibility-guidelines/README.md`.

### Open questions

- **Prefixed or bare slugs? **Resolved — neither. Flat `storefront-team` / `storefront-team-3g`, no nesting.
- **Two child handles, or one merged handle? **Resolved — neither. Two independent flat handles, two team docs, two commands.
- **Is the 3G / Sofa split permanent or transitional? **Resolved — permanent. 3G and SOFA are not merging; they're always-separate teams that happened to share a ticket.
- **editorPreview.js carve-out? **Resolved — stays a `storefront-team` (SOFA) carve-out.
- **Does DevRel sit under storefront-team or stay top-level? **Resolved — top-level, already live.
- **Which paths beyond Partner Portal go to DevRel? **Still open — worth checking developer/addon docs and `api/doc/openapi` (today `@shoptet/api-team` via the `/api` rule).
- **Do the Slack channels merge as well? **Resolved — no, left untouched.
- **Sequencing: **still blocking. As of 2026-09-16, neither `storefront-team-3g` nor the renamed `storefront-team` exist yet as GitHub teams (the old `sofa-team` / `templates-devrel-team` are still the live ones). Create and populate the GitHub teams before merging this PR.

### Acceptance criteria

- Zero occurrences of `templates-devrel-team`, `sofa-team`, `storefront-3g` or `storefront-sofa` left in the repo (grep, excluding `.git` and worktrees).
- Every new handle in CODEOWNERS resolves — open a throwaway PR touching one file per team and confirm GitHub actually requests that team's review. This is the only real check, since CI does not validate CODEOWNERS.
- `/st-ownership <path>` returns the new handle and loads a team doc that exists, for one path in each of `storefront-team`, `storefront-team-3g` and `devrel-team`.
- The Cypress `team-check` job still returns true for a member of `storefront-team-3g` — verify on a real PR, not by reading the YAML.
- `make lint-agents-skills` and `make lint-agents-rules` pass.
